questions: Section 14 gives income multiples but neither a debit nor an action. Here $2,500,000 applied for plus $100,000 in force is $2,600,000 against a 20x limit of $1,040,000 at age 44. Which of the four decisions does an overage of that size call for - accept as applied, accept with a modifier, postpone, or decline?

Section 4 tables the systolic and diastolic bands for an untreated reading and separately charges 25 on treatment. This applicant is treated and reads 143/84, above the 138 systolic threshold and so not at target. Do I charge 25 for treatment only, or 25 for treatment plus 25 for the 139-148 systolic band?

Section 12 charges 25 for elevated liver enzymes but also refers borderline liver chemistry to judgement. For enzymes elevated yet below twice the upper limit of normal, with no alcohol history and no treatment history, is the charge the full 25 or less?
If financial underwriting rather than the debit total drives the outcome on this file, what rating class is reported alongside that decision - the class the debit total reads to, or none?
